description: Validate a Google Search campaign exactly as the dashboard does, and ask Google to validate it without creating anything. Returns approvalHash, the schedule as Google will run it and the budget it would hold. Creates nothing, spends nothing, holds no budget. Show the result to the user before any create. Early access — owner-only until Google verifies campaign management. Needs an API key the owner allowed to run ad campaigns (Account → Developers). A refusal says which rule stopped it (key permission, server switch, campaign or monthly cap, budget, Google review gate, not connected).

connectionId.description: From recomention_ads_list: the owner's selected Google Ads account.

draftId.description: An approved marketing draft from recomention_ads_list: its copy is the only copy allowed.

finalUrl.description: An HTTPS page on the project's own domain, without utm_* parameters (recomention adds its own).

firstDay.description: yyyy-MM-dd in the ad account's time zone; after today.

geoTargetIds.description: Google geo target IDs, e.g. 2840 for the United States.

lastDay.description: yyyy-MM-dd; at least 4 days in all, within one UTC month.

lifetimeCap.description: The most the campaign may ever spend, USD. Held against the month's budget from create.

maxCpc.description: Maximum cost per click, USD; at most the lifetime cap.

nonPolitical.description: The campaign is not political advertising.

name: recomention_ads_draft
title: Draft a Google Search campaign (no spend)
